parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a lever or handle made of stainless steel, typically small and cylindrical, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot axis to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape, and connects the spout and switch.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, providing structural integrity and housing the internal water channels.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet tube made of stainless steel through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the faucet body to the sink, ensuring smooth and controlled flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
